filing_cabinet.notes: Three separate hollow drawers; interact is a 0.5s open/close cycle on middle drawer, matching filingcabinet.dm. Other drawers can be moved directly. Same mesh layout for grey/white/employment versions.

employment_cabinet.notes: Three separate hollow drawers; interact is a 0.5s open/close cycle on middle drawer, matching filingcabinet.dm. Other drawers can be moved directly. Same mesh layout for grey/white/employment versions.

filing_cabinet_white.notes: Three separate hollow drawers; interact is a 0.5s open/close cycle on middle drawer, matching filingcabinet.dm. Other drawers can be moved directly. Same mesh layout for grey/white/employment versions.

drawer_cabinet.notes: Three separate hollow drawers; interact is a 0.5s open/close cycle on middle drawer, matching filingcabinet.dm. Other drawers can be moved directly. Same mesh layout for grey/white/employment versions.

wooden_dresser.notes: Static source dresser used for clothing/customisation; no drawer animation in original gameplay.

display_case.notes: Separate transparent hinged hood and Showpiece attachment. Broken hides hood; contents stay independent. Sale case uses original laserbox base. Runtime permission/stock states remain gameplay controlled.

food_display_case.notes: Separate transparent hinged hood and Showpiece attachment. Broken hides hood; contents stay independent. Sale case uses original laserbox base. Runtime permission/stock states remain gameplay controlled.

pet_bed.notes: Low octagonal woven pet bed; 1.44m footprint.

linen_bin.notes: Full/half/empty clips change linen level; shell is hollow and uses linenbin-empty.

bench_middle.notes: 2m modular bench. Neutral original GAGS cover is independently tintable. Join ends at X +/-1; rotate corner 90 degrees. No baked rainbow mapping sprite.

bench_left.notes: 2m modular bench. Neutral original GAGS cover is independently tintable. Join ends at X +/-1; rotate corner 90 degrees. No baked rainbow mapping sprite.

bench_right.notes: 2m modular bench. Neutral original GAGS cover is independently tintable. Join ends at X +/-1; rotate corner 90 degrees. No baked rainbow mapping sprite.

bench_solo.notes: 2m modular bench. Neutral original GAGS cover is independently tintable. Join ends at X +/-1; rotate corner 90 degrees. No baked rainbow mapping sprite.

bench_corner.notes: 2m modular bench. Neutral original GAGS cover is independently tintable. Join ends at X +/-1; rotate corner 90 degrees. No baked rainbow mapping sprite.

easel.notes: Tripod easel with empty Canvas attachment; paintings are separate content, not baked into the texture.

desk_bell.notes: Small tabletop prop with local floor origin; ring clip, sound supplied by gameplay.

water_cooler.notes: Removable jug, independent reagent tint/level and cup attachment. Tipped gameplay state can rotate entire root onto its side; no texture repaint.

mop_bucket.notes: Hollow container, independent original water overlay with empty/filled clips. Cart equipment uses named attachments and is not permanently baked into cart mesh.

janitorial_cart.notes: Hollow container, independent original water overlay with empty/filled clips. Cart equipment uses named attachments and is not permanently baked into cart mesh.

vault_safe.notes: Separate side-hinged door, real interior, Contents anchor. Locked/unlocked share closed appearance in source; open/close clips.

punching_bag.notes: Ceiling suspension fits below 2m. Bag pivots at hanger; punch reaction clip.

chest_press.notes: Source workout flick lasts 0.8s. Moving exercise component separated from frame, User_Seat attachment. Runtime controls repetitions. Rear/side fallback surfaces use calm original-palette texels; rigid contact assemblies united to remove coplanar overlaps.

bench_press.notes: Source workout flick lasts 0.8s. Moving exercise component separated from frame, User_Seat attachment. Runtime controls repetitions. Rear/side fallback surfaces use calm original-palette texels; rigid contact assemblies united to remove coplanar overlaps.

training_machine.notes: Mobile platform; target/toolbox/rider are separate gameplay attachments. Movement across cells is runtime controlled, not baked into idle model.

altar.notes: Original convertaltar wood/cloth, separate cloth for sect-state UV switching. Candle anchors; flame effects belong to gameplay.
